name: Generation Ships
description: An early-game crisis: once the first empires reach tech level 3, a giant world ship and its escort arrive at the galaxy edge, scout a populated colony and, a year and a half later, demand it. Four kinds of arrival (Pilgrims, Heirs, Ark Faith, the Quiet Ship), each with its own story and choices. Cede the world, offer another, or fight. One ship per six empires (up to four), 2-4 years apart, each at a different empire; their big, slow, old-tech fleets raid gas mining stations before the assault, and survivors of a lost war turn pirate.
